q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a two-wheeler helmet?
title: Helmet carbon footprint per helmet
short: Weigh the ABS or polycarbonate shell, EPS liner, visor, padding and straps per helmet and multiply by supplier figures. Add moulding, painting and assembly energy, then divide the plant's energy by helmets passed.

ul: ABS or polycarbonate shell, or fibreglass.

p: Report per helmet by type and weight.

example.title: Worked example: helmet unit per helmet (one month)
lines: Plant total: 28,400 / 50,000 = 0.568 kg CO2 per helmet
Add plastics and padding for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
